svg.title: IPv4 hiding the interior behind NAT compared with IPv6 exposing every address, plus three checks before enabling dual stack
svg.desc: Left: in IPv4 an internal 10.1.1.0/24 with no NAT mapping is unreachable from the internet, so the default deny is a side effect that exists even if nobody wrote it, but security teams mistake the presence of NAT for isolation and that assumption disappears in IPv6. Right: in IPv6 an internal 2001:db8:1::/64 is forwarded without translation and is directly reachable, so the deny has to be written explicitly, illustrated by an access list whose first line denies and logs everything before permitting one service, with the dual-stack gap where IPv4 has a policy and IPv6 falls through the default. Three checks are listed: policy parity for every IPv4 rule including deny and log, multi-prefix source selection where two provider-aggregatable prefixes plus RFC 6724 can send the reply out of the other exit, and monitoring that does not filter ICMPv6 wholesale because neighbour discovery and path MTU discovery depend on it.
svg.text: IPv6 is not the same design twice - it is a different exposure surface
IPv4 hides the interior behind NAT by accident. IPv6 has no accident: every policy has to be written, including the default deny.
IPv4: HIDDEN BY TRANSLATION
入向默认拒绝是“副作用”
内网
NAT
无映射
互联网
不可达
没有静态映射或发布，外部永远到不了内部 -
这是一份“忘了写也安全”的默认值
风险：安全团队把“NAT 存在”当成隔离
迁移到 IPv6 时这层假设消失
同时：IPv4 的 ACL 往往只写了 v4 部分
IPv6: EXPOSED BY DEFAULT
每个地址全球可达，拒绝必须显式写
内网
无 NAT
逐跳转发
互联网
可直接到达
ipv6 access-list EDGE-IN
deny ipv6 any any log <- 默认拒绝
permit tcp any host 2001:db8:9::80 eq 443
双栈缺口：v4 写了策略，v6 走默认放行
同一条服务在 v6 上暴露面积更大
还要写：源地址选择 / 多前缀回程
Three checks before enabling dual stack on the edge
1. Policy parity: every IPv4 rule has an IPv6 twin, including deny and log; a v6 default permit is the classic finding in audits.
2. Multi-prefix source selection: two PA prefixes plus RFC 6724 can send the reply out of the other exit - test it, do not assume.
3. Monitoring: ICMPv6 must not be filtered wholesale (ND, PMTUD); filtering it breaks IPv6 in ways ICMPv4 never did.
The migration incident that repeats: IPv4 hardened for years, IPv6 enabled in one change window, and the first scan finds the interior.
